observations: Photo 0 shows a large kitchen range with a black cooktop, wooden front panel, and multiple knobs. The brand 'BRUHM' is visible on the front panel.
The cooktop has four gas burners on the left and right, and two central electric coil burners.
Photo 1 shows the oven door open, revealing two racks and a clean interior. The oven appears to be electric.
Photo 2 is a duplicate of Photo 0, showing the same angle and details.
The unit is placed on a concrete floor in what appears to be a workshop or storage area.
There is visible wear on the wooden panel, including scratches and discoloration.

claims.claim: Neatly used bruhm cooker, 4 gas cooker and 2 electric cooker
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 2 show 4 gas burners and 2 electric coil burners. The brand 'BRUHM' is visible on the front panel in both photos.

risks.risk: The electric burners or oven may not be functional.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the electric burners and oven in operation.

risks.risk: Gas burners may have clogged nozzles or faulty ignition.
risks.proof: A close-up video of each gas burner being lit and burning evenly.

risks.risk: The wooden panel may be damaged or warped, affecting aesthetics and durability.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the wooden panel showing the extent of scratches and discoloration.

proof_requests: Video showing the electric burners and oven in operation.
Close-up video of each gas burner being lit and burning evenly.
Close-up photo of the wooden panel showing the extent of scratches and discoloration.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a BRUHM 6-burner gas and electric cooker, with 4 gas and 2 electric burners as claimed. The photos support the seller's description. However, functionality of the electric and gas components is unverified, and cosmetic wear on the wooden panel is visible. The item can be priced at its worst case (non-functional electric components, cosmetic damage) until proof of operation and condition is provided.
